# One payment of BILL-USD-001, made of two splits of one transaction.
#
# The bill half of `a_payment_naming_two_settling_splits.txt`. Nothing about
# the spelling changes on this side: the money left once, so it is one block,
# and the splits it names are the payable ones.
#
# What this fixture produces: both payable splits in the bill's lot, the bill
# settled, and the ledger and the printed page each writing one `payment:`
# block whose `amount:` is the whole 100.00.
#
# Verified by
# tests/integration/test_linking_a_split_not_on_the_receivable.py.
bill "BILL-USD-001"
  vendor_id: "V-US"
  currency: USD
  date_opened: 2026-01-05
  entry:
    date: 2026-01-05
    description: "Parts"
    account: "Expenses:Supplies"
    quantity: 1
    price: 100
    taxable: false
  posted:
    date: 2026-01-05
    due: 2026-02-05
    ap_account: "Liabilities:Accounts Payable USD"
    memo: "Bill BILL-USD-001"
    accumulate: true
  payment:
    date: 2026-02-27
    amount: 100
    account: "Assets:Bank:USD"
    Transaction "9a8b7c6d5e4f30211203344556677889"
      PaymentSplit "b7c6d5e4f30211203344556677889900"
      PaymentSplit "c6d5e4f3021120334455667788990011"
